bullets: Added a solo discount to full-access accounts, lowering the session price when no other accounts are active.
Fixed the invalid skills refusal message to name the specific rejected skill and field instead of showing a generic note.
Updated the model picker for full-access users to offer GPT-6 Luna, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and MiMo 2.6 Pro.
Changed the label for the first model slot from Efficient to Fast for full-access users.
Removed confirmation prompts for session and model switches for full-access users.
Promoted Germany and Switzerland from free tier 3 to tier 2.
Renamed the MiMo Fast model to MiMo v2.6 Flash Fast in the model catalog.
Added a 1x price label for models that cost exactly one hour of balance.
Updated the cloud-to-desktop sync database from a shared system to a dedicated one.
Switched the community pages and UI preset library to a new internal storage system.
Added a safety check that stops cloud file downloads if the file changes midway.
Limited the number of code changes that can be bundled in one cloud project upload to 500.
Updated the internal system that handles updates from GitHub to a newer processing route.
Added a tracking event for new user purchases that includes a specific dollar amount and label.
Added a quiet comparison mode for the internal management dashboard to check two data stores.
